title: Ulyana and the Letters
author: Hazel Voss
blurb: Wren Halloran, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
